Term1: Staphylococcus aureus infections in bone or joint prostheses
Text:
# STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS INFECTIONS IN BONE OR JOINT PROSTHESES

Consult Infectious Diseases for specific management advice.

# Treatment Following 2-stage Exchange or Resection Arthroplasty Without Planned

# Staged Reimplantation of Prosthesis

Treat with intravenous antibiotic for 6 weeks for all joint types.

# Treatment Following 1-Stage Exchange of Prosthesis

Treat with intravenous antibiotic for 2 to 6 weeks followed by 3 months of an oral antibiotic combined with rifampin for all joint types.

# Rifampin Synergy

Rifampin is recommended for treatment with debridement and retention or one stage exchange. When rifampin is combined with a beta-lactam or vancomycin in vitro, bacterial killing is enhanced. Do not use rifampin alone, as bacterial resistance develops rapidly. If patient does not tolerate rifampin it may be omitted from treatment regimen. Contact Infectious Diseases for more information.

# Chronic Suppression

Chronic suppression with oral antimicrobials may follow treatment based on individual patient circumstances.

Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment Following Debridement and Retention of Prosthesis

Treat with intravenous antibiotic for 2 to 6 weeks followed by 3 to 6 months of an oral antibiotic combined with rifampin (3 months in total hip, elbow, shoulder and ankle arthroplasty and 6 months in total knee arthroplasty).

### Oral Treatment for Continuation of Therapy or Chronic Suppression

Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO BID ($) R

MRSA or allergy to penicillin or cephalosporin
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID ($) R,DI

< OR >
Minocycline 100mg PO BID ($) DI

### Rifampin Synergy for Debridement and Retention or One Stage Exchange (Not For

### Chronic Suppression)

In addition to PO treatment above < ADD >
Rifampin 600 mg PO QDay ($) DI,O

## Outpatient

### Treatment Following Debridement and Retention of Prosthesis

Treat with intravenous antibiotic for 2 to 6 weeks followed by 3 to 6 months of an oral antibiotic combined with rifampin (3 months in total hip, elbow, shoulder and ankle arthroplasty and 6 months in total knee arthroplasty).

### Oral Treatment for Continuation of Therapy or Chronic Suppression

Cephalexin 500 mg PO QID ($) [R]
< OR >
Dicloxacillin 500 mg PO QID ($) [DI]

MRSA or allergy to penicillin or cephalosporin
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID ($) R,DI

< OR >
Clindamycin 300 mg PO QID ($) [H,O]
< OR >
Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID ($) [DI]

### Rifampin Synergy for Debridement and Retention or One Stage Exchange (Not For

### Chronic Suppression)

In addition to PO treatment above < ADD >
Rifampin 600 mg PO QDay ($) DI,O
